text:
alex_sales: FYI BigBank just sent back the security pack. they want a clear plan for a walled-DC POC: delivery method, upgrade cadence, and pricing floor. can SE/eng weigh in?

marta_se: Got it. do they insist on physical media, or will a controlled s3 + airgap sync be ok?

alex_sales: They prefer no outbound egress. physical is preferred but expensive. asked about 'sideload cassette' via courier.

own_eng: Physical media is doable. two main workstreams: 1) build signed delta bundles (Notary v2 compatible) 2) provide an explicit upgrade cadence + manifest format so their ops can validate.

jess_secbiz: Also flagged: must present KMS/HSM flow for signing and FIPS-140-2 compatibility on the agent. do we have formal language for that in the PSQ?

marta_se: We do, but need to call out limitations: our default image signing uses our internal signing key; for air-gapped customers we can support a BYO notary key or provide an HSM-anchored signing process. add note about key escrow being a separate contract.

ryan_sol: For the POC, recommend we offer two delivery SKUs: "USB-mini" (single full image) and "Delta-cartridge" (initial image + staged delta bundles). Pricing: USB-mini one-time handling + per-month offline support. Delta bundles lighter weight, cheaper per-update.

alex_sales: They asked about upgrade frequency: monthly security patches, quarterly feature deltas. can we commit to that cadence for sealed deployments?

own_eng: We can commit to monthly security deltas and quarterly feature deltas for the POC window (3 months). After that we'd offer an enterprise cadence SLA (negotiable). Need to document rollback playbook and retained-manifest retention window (we keep manifests for 90 days).

jess_secbiz: PSQ item: do we provide binary SBOMs for the images? BigBank requires SBOM + checksum + PGP-style signature.

marta_se: Yes — we can export SBOMs in SPDX format and include sha256 checksums. signatures are Notary v2 (or detached PGP if they insist). note: detached signatures increase verification steps for their ops.

ryan_sol: Logistics question: if they pick courier USB, what's lead time? ops needs ETA for procurement.

own_eng: Typical build -> sign -> QA -> package -> ship is 7–10 business days for first image. Deltas are 2–3 days once delta pipeline is approved.

marta_se: Need to answer PSQ Q12 about telemetry: we currently disable outbound telemetry in private deployments; we can provide an explicit opt-in for offline heartbeat via customer-managed collection node.

alex_sales: Great. next steps: owen, can you draft a short runbook (one-pager) covering: media options, signing choices, upgrade cadence, rollback steps, SBOM + checksum format and lead times? Marta/Jess please review for PSQ language. I'll send to BigBank by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: build #5143 for sealed-image succeeded — artifact: sealed-image-2026-03-22.tar.gz (sha256: abc123...)

owen_eng: On it, drafting now. will upload runbook link when ready.

marta_se: I'll review and add PSQ snippets.

jess_secbiz: I'll supply the HSM/KMS wording and a note on contract scoping for key custody. :thumbsup:

alex_sales: thanks team — can we sync 10am PST tomorrow if runbook ready?

own_eng: yes 10am works.

alex_sales: tagging the buyer contact: @mike_bigbank — we'll follow up with proposed runbook and pricing SKUs.

ryan_sol: also note pricing: include an "embargo premium" line item for sealed shipments to cover cold-chain and handling.

alex_sales: added. closing thread for now.
